composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_3 is hovering over a lab microscope station, using a thin metallic probe to examine a block of brittle, pale ash-grey volcanic tuff. The concrete-like ash matrix beautifully frames a perfectly articulated Microraptor zhaoianus skeleton with a distinct carbonized halo of body feathers. Directed cool museum spotlighting reflecting off her bright orange pumps. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
